Linguistics at Huddersfield Seminar Series

Tags: events

Fransina Stradling @f.stradling #1 2021-10-12 16:53 UTC

I am pleased to share the schedule for the Autumn 2021 Linguistics Research Seminars hosted by the University of Huddersfield Linguistics and Modern Languages department.

All seminars take place on Wednesdays and are scheduled to start at 15.30 BST/GMT. Talks typically last between 30 and 50 minutes and are followed by 10 to 15 minutes of discussion.

Seminars will take place virtually via Zoom. You will need to register for each seminar separately to receive a Zoom link for the event, which you will receive the day before the seminar takes place. Registration links for each seminar can be found here.

All welcome!

For more information contact Dan McIntyre at [email redacted].
